tenantAppUnavailable.title: Reconnecting to Paperclip
tenantAppUnavailable.body: Paperclip is restarting or updating. Please try again in a moment.

tenantAppStarting.title: Paperclip is starting
tenantAppStarting.body: Paperclip is starting up. Please try again in a few seconds.

workerUnavailable.title: Plugin unavailable
workerUnavailable.body: This plugin is restarting. Please try again in a moment.

timeout.title: Request timed out
timeout.body: This took too long to respond. Please try again in a moment.

interactionAudienceDenied.title: You can’t respond to this card
interactionAudienceDenied.body: You are not in this card's resolver audience.

interactionForbidden.title: You can’t respond to this card
interactionForbidden.body: You do not have permission to respond to this card.

interactionSettled.title: Already handled
interactionSettled.body: This request is no longer waiting for a decision.

transient.title: Connection interrupted
transient.body: Paperclip is temporarily unavailable. Please try again in a moment.

auth.title: Signed out
auth.body: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.

forbidden.title: Not allowed
forbidden.body: You don’t have permission to do that.

notFound.title: Not found
notFound.body: This item doesn’t exist or was moved.

conflict.title: Out of date
conflict.body: This changed since you loaded it. Refresh and try again.

invalid.title: Check your input
invalid.body: Some details aren’t valid. Review them and try again.

unknown.title: Something went wrong
unknown.body: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again.
